subject.title: fix(line): dripping inbound media downloads hang past setup timeout

question: Should LINE inbound media adopt a 120-second absolute body-transfer deadline after readiness succeeds?
rationale: LINE documents delayed content preparation but no transfer deadline; choosing an absolute ceiling intentionally changes existing delivery behavior for slow large media and cannot be settled by unit tests alone.

options.title: Accept 120 seconds with proof
options.body: Require redacted real LINE evidence for successful normal media and bounded stalled-body failure, then accept the sibling-aligned ceiling.

options.title: Use a progress-aware bound
options.body: Replace the absolute ceiling with a maintainer-approved transfer-progress or minimum-throughput policy if valid LINE media can exceed 120 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept 120 seconds with proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real LINE evidence for successful normal media and bounded stalled-body failure, then accept the sibling-aligned ceiling.
